Chapter 6645: A New Immortal Soon

Chapter 6645: A New Immortal Soon

Everyone thought boredom would come after the end of the battle and the overlords’ departure. However, a phenomenon in the sky surprised everyone - a golden glow reaching all crevices including the two major heavens.

Each blade of grass and pebble shone brilliantly. This was more than just being illuminated by another source. Water itself became golden as well.

Some noticed this also happened at the two redemption grounds.

“What is going on?” Others were afraid of this golden glow.

“The world is changing?” Everyone found this abnormal.

“I just hope it’s not something bad.” Many prayed in response, hoping not to be punished for their sins. The lack of knowledge became a source of fear.

The two immortals from the redemption grounds became serious.

“An immortal tribulation.” One knew exactly what was going on.

Primal ancestors and heaven-slayers lacked the same information. They had never seen such an overwhelming phenomenon before. It came without warning and took over instantly.

As for the overlords, they knew it didn’t come from a known cultivator. Therefore, there could only be one explanation - the high heaven.

“Why is the heaven doing this?” An overlord became nervous. Was it descending?

“Someone is becoming an immortal soon.” Weizhen inside Supreme Heaven had a frightening glint in his eyes.

Eventually, weaker cultivators understood the phenomenon came from above.

“Can this be the sign of a calamity?” An emperor panicked.

Solutions existed for other problems but not a calamity from the high heaven.

“Should we run?” Many’s first reaction was to run.

“To where?” However, a primal ancestor shook his head helplessly.

For example, this golden glow covered all things. This included the most hidden grottos.

However, news from overlords spread fast from the two heavens - someone was going to become an immortal.

It traveled swiftly across Three Immortals and shocked everyone, revealing that the phenomenon was a tribulation.

“A tribulation meant for an immortal!” All understood the reason behind the golden glow’s presence.

“There is nowhere to run.” A primal ancestor said.

Whoever the tribulation was meant for couldn’t avoid it.

“Truly unprecedented, not even for a primordial immortal.” An ancient immortal murmured.

“Is it more of a punishment than a tribulation?” The ancient immortal from the other redemption ground said.

“It is unavoidable.” Li Qiye himself gazed at the sky.

The only option for the unknown cultivator was to face it directly.

“Why is this tribulation happening?” Somewhere else, an overlord wondered.

The overlords knew there were ways of avoiding or delaying a tribulation. For example, as long as the person didn’t become an immortal, the tribulation wouldn’t descend.
